title: Docstyle embedded metadata catalogue, version 1
description: The embedded catalogue carried in the DOCX OPC part /docstyle/catalogue.json (content type application/vnd.docstyle.catalogue+json, related from /word/document.xml by https://dougmanuel.github.io/docstyle/relationships/catalogue). It is public_projection(local state): restricted records never enter it. JSON Schema cannot express reference closure, view-path resolution, collection scope and ordering, or contribution-position uniqueness; the semantic validator (tests/vnext/conformance/lib/catalogue.lua) enforces those beside this schema. Record definitions are reused from metadata-core.v1 and document-model.v1 by cross-file $ref; constraints that must accompany a reused definition use the wrapper pattern (properties beside anyOf: [{$ref}]) because keywords beside $ref are ignored.

document.description: Closure-required reference to the document record in records.

records.description: Every public authority record, keyed by id. Excludes metadata-view records, which occur only in views.

views.description: The metadata-view record for every generated region present in the document, keyed by id (= the region's field-envelope id).

objects.description: Public projection of table and figure node semantics, keyed by node id.

assets.description: Public, portable asset records, keyed by id.

public-record.description: A public authority record (privacy absent means public for metadata records): a core record, whose document form carries only the canonical region-form abstract, or a profile-typed record. Every public record is carried.

profile-record.description: Structural gate only for a profile-typed record: any record naming a profile. Like state-metadata.v1's records[] branch 2 it cannot know the profile's real shape, so the semantic validator (lib/catalogue.lua) validates every such record against its profile's own schema and fails closed when that profile is unavailable -- the catalogue never carries a profile record unvalidated.

object.description: {id, type, semantics} for one table or figure node; semantics must be canonical for the node type, and an embedded (public) figure must carry alt text.
